subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan become a bundled qwen provider/onboarding auth surface, or remain custom-provider/external-plugin work for now?
rationale: The request fits the model-provider roadmap, but accepting it publishes a new provider/config/auth support contract that automation should not approve without maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept bundled qwen Token Plan
options.body: Proceed with review of the linked PR after any merge-readiness fixes, making qwen-token-plan an official bundled provider surface.

options.title: Route to external plugin/custom config
options.body: Keep core lean by declining bundled ownership and documenting the custom-provider or external-plugin path instead.

options.title: Defer pending stronger vendor evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers get more confidence in Alibaba's recommended ids, regions, catalog stability, and support expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled qwen Token Plan
recommendation.body: Proceed with review of the linked PR after any merge-readiness fixes, making qwen-token-plan an official bundled provider surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The qwen provider surface was introduced in commits authored by Peter Steinberger and this decision extends that same provider boundary.
